sources.title: Integrate conversation references into opencode-annotate
sources.quote: lets do a sub function to acomodate opencode-annotate
sources.note: Approved two agent tools plus /ref as an integrated feature, verified locally. Message IDs are unavailable in the harness. Partial records that provenance gap. The approved implementation endpoint does not include publishing or changing the daily installation. Official V2 plugin/client APIs were checked against the installed 2.2.0 runtime.

sources.title: Remove the redundant reviewer repository and launch Annotate
sources.quote: @mj-project remove unwanted repo and launch this
sources.note: Authorizes releasing the integrated project and removing the previously identified nxxxsooo/plannotator-tui repository and local checkout. The subsequent launch-scope choice was Include both (Recommended), covering the TUI and conversation references. Both removals were verified on 2026-10-29 after 0.10.0 publication; recovery history is retained privately. Message IDs are not exposed by the harness.
